images.alt_text: A burgundy splayed folio compares two theorem statements on translucent sheets and distributes a single raw export to three independent checker prisms.

visual_signature.metaphor: A printmaker’s folio opens diagonally across the sheet: two separately typeset statements align in a translucent registration window; a stitched proof volume yields a sealed export strip checked by independent readers. Show the Mathlib statement, matching theorem, repeated builds and proof-checker agreement as separate evidence. Avoid claims about independent discovery or a proof generated by AI.

images.alt_text: A turquoise helical cutaway steps through the same paired core blocks three times before the amber path reaches the final layers.

visual_signature.metaphor: A precise colored-pencil axonometric foldout of a stack of four six-layer sections, shown as sliced architectural strata. An indigo upper prelude fans out to all three passes through the same pair of teal central blocks. Unrolled passes are linked by clear amber message ribbons. A single final block returns a next-token prediction. Group equivalent middle blocks by shared weights. No live steering controls or knobs.
visual_signature.hierarchy: three repeated middle blocks seen from a single shared prelude

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: The amber path descends through three labeled passes of paired middle blocks. Only its final pass feeds the final layers. The fixed-release label sits apart. The three stages and output remain identifiable in the 320 px export.
